subject: Issue with running app with a .DLL file

messages.author: 63c6a5fb0e177668
messages.subject: Issue with running app with a .DLL file
parts:
I have an app folder called rtestapp with the following files in it:

rtest.R
server.R
ui.R
test1.dll

The rtest.R file start with line           
dyn.load("test1.dll") 
......
...

and in my server.R i source the rtest.R

The app works fine on my local desktop since the files are in the same folder and sourcing works.
However, when i upload to shinyapp.io i am getting the following error - seems like it cannot find the test1.dll

Any assistance here will be very helpful.

======================================================================

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Error in dyn.load("test1.dll") : unable to load shared object '/srv/shiny-server/rtestapp/test1.dll': /srv/shiny-server/rtestapp/test1.dll: invalid ELF header Calls: runApp ... eval -> source -> withVisible -> eval -> eval -> dyn.load Execution halted

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Issue with running app with a .DLL file
parts:
Hi,

ShinyApps runs on Linux, and is unable to load Windows DDL files. You will have to compile your library for Linux.

-Andy
